title: The invariant: no live session without a live key, none begun at or before the mark
assertion: Held today by its parts: the database refuses any key session whose digest is not a live key of the account and any session begun at or before the account's mark (SGN-20, SGN-17), and a confirmation that commits on a second connection after the app read the registry and before the session's insert is refused under the account's lock and answered as a stale session (SGN-26, case 7). Not yet written: the property over interleavings of sign-in, confirmation, End membership and reset in each order of the account lock, and the count that resolveSession issues the same statements as before the registry
noFileReason: Synthetic personas and keys the tests make in memory (a software authenticator, a provider twin); no file.
notes: The property over interleavings (sign-in, confirmation, End membership and reset in each order of the account lock) and resolveSession's statement count are not yet written; the named tests hold the invariant's parts (SGN-20's refusals, SGN-26 case 7 on two connections).
